question_text: What is the primary operational sub-sector (Solar & Wind Generation, Battery & Energy Storage, or Grid Infrastructure / OT)?
remediation_action: Determine the CleanTech sub-sector to trigger specific federal subsidy, grid compliance, and supply chain pathways.

question_text: Does the project strictly comply with the IRA Prevailing Wage and Apprenticeship (PWA) requirements to secure the 5x tax credit multiplier?
remediation_action: Audit EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contracts to mandate certified payroll reporting and PWA compliance.

question_text: Are all tier-one suppliers and equity sponsors screened to ensure no Prohibited Foreign Entities (PFEs) or Foreign Entities of Concern (FEOC) are involved, preventing total credit disqualification?
remediation_action: Require written FEOC representation covering ownership to the ultimate parent and execute a Material Assistance Cost Ratio (MACR) audit.

question_text: Can the project provide audit-ready supplier certifications proving it meets the IRA Domestic Content Bonus thresholds (e.g., 100% US steel/iron and 40%+ manufactured products)?
remediation_action: Secure formal Domestic Content Certification Statements (via Form 8835/3468) from all component manufacturers.

question_text: Under FERC Order 2023, has the project secured 100% site control and submitted the required commercial readiness deposits to enter the interconnection queue?
remediation_action: Execute binding site leases and submit financial deposits to prevent the project from being dropped from the regional ISO/RTO queue.

question_text: Are binding long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) or virtual PPAs (vPPAs) executed with investment-grade corporate or utility off-takers?
remediation_action: Secure long-term off-take agreements with defined strike prices to stabilize projected cash flows and bankability.

question_text: Has a comprehensive Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) been completed in compliance with NEPA, avoiding critical habitat and endangered species overlap?
remediation_action: Commission third-party environmental and biological surveys to clear state and federal permitting bottlenecks.

question_text: Are critical battery minerals (e.g., lithium, cobalt) sourced domestically or from US Free-Trade Agreement (FTA) countries to maintain Section 45X and Section 30D eligibility?
remediation_action: Restructure supply chain procurement to eliminate sourcing from prohibited covered nations and secure FTA certificates of origin.

question_text: Does the financial model include a funded performance warranty reserve accounting for long-term cell degradation and HVAC augmentation costs?
remediation_action: Establish a dedicated cash reserve explicitly modeled against the projected degradation curve of deployed battery assets.

question_text: Is the Operational Technology (OT) network strictly air-gapped and segmented from the IT network in compliance with NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) standards?
remediation_action: Execute an architecture overhaul to establish hardware firewalls and strict segmentation between IT enterprise systems and physical grid OT.

question_text: Has a fully funded Decommissioning Plan been established to cover end-of-life Asset Retirement Obligations (AROs), including solar panel recycling and site restoration?
remediation_action: Establish a surety bond or letter of credit specifically earmarked for end-of-life facility decommissioning.
